result.summary: The page renders largely as intended with no clearly broken functionality. The only notable concerns are minor: some low-contrast gray text (search placeholder and secondary labels) and a cramped, edge-adjacent rating display in the "Popular right now" list.

issues.description: The search placeholder text ("Restaurants, dishes, groceries") and the muted delivery-fee text (e.g., "€0.90 delivery") appear as low-contrast light gray on white, which may be difficult to read for users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder and secondary text colors to meet WCAG contrast requirements (at least 4.5:1 for normal text).

issues.description: In the "Popular right now" section, the rating badge reads "4.8 (500+)" with the star icon and number in black, but the count text is rendered in a lighter gray, and the rating sits very close to the right screen edge, making the row feel cramped and slightly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding to the card metadata row and use consistent color/weight for the rating count so the text does not appear to run into the viewport edge.
